description: Values are escaped for single-quoted JavaScript strings by escaping the quote but not the backslash, at every place that builds a script from tool arguments.

provenance.construction: reverse of 23f1319def: the new side of the diff is the code before the change

expected.rationale: A value ending in a backslash neutralizes the escaping quote and lets the rest of the argument run as code in the browser page. The same incomplete rule is repeated at many call sites, while other code in the file still escapes backslashes first (the `val` line in selectOption), which shows the intended rule. GitHub rated the advisory medium.

issues.description: The value is escaped with replace(/'/g, "\\'") only; a backslash in the input is not escaped, so it can break out of the single-quoted JavaScript string. The same incomplete escape appears at the other call sites.
